items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Yang Johnson. ... [INTERVIEWEE] I remember all them old fellas.

ctx.x: Yeah. No. By the river. Back then, no. I was on Turo. I was on Turo in, let's see, Claymore. By the Turo in between Johnson and Priya. I was living on Turo.
They got a bar in there now, Gail, tell me. Yeah, but two or three blocks down. On Priya.
